decision: use six dependent PRs with high verification rigor
why: authentication private media and production infrastructure have high blast radius

decision: add an isolated apps/studio Worker
why: the marketing and private production applications have different users data and release cadence

decision: use native D1 for Better Auth and direct prepared SQL for Studio
why: one metadata store and no unused abstraction keeps request traces short

decision: use authenticated Worker-mediated R2 multipart uploads
why: parts stay below request limits while every byte write retains session authorization

decision: start with authenticated R2 range playback and defer Stream
why: the requested controls work for browser-compatible exports and format fixtures can prove whether transcoding is needed

decision: use Cloudflare Email Routing sends restricted to verified product users
why: the initial dashboard state had no eligible Email Sending zone; onboarding studio-mail.youraveragetechbro.com later replaced this design

decision: create verify-studio in PR STUDIO-01 and maintain it after every later direct proof
why: a runnable verification contract must exist before feature breadth grows

decision: use autopilot-full with merge-then-branch dependencies
why: each PR should land as a coherent production-shaped increment instead of one coupled final stack

decision: let the root review evidence and merge without an operator pause
why: the user granted autonomous implementation and merge authority

decision: use D1 as the sole runtime allowlist source
why: a fixed application list would drift from administrator revocation

decision: accept only the expected generated probe environment file, delete it, then scan the emitted bundle for the probe value
why: Cloudflare Vite copies an app-local .dev.vars file into its server output; deployment output must contain neither that file nor the secret value

decision: use native light dark and system themes with a pre-CSS initializer
why: the stored choice applies before paint without adding a runtime dependency

decision: use a 25 ms additive list overhead limit instead of a ratio against the empty trunk shell
why: trunk production p95 is 10.9 ms so a ratio overstates a 6.9 ms planning cost; the 750 ms list and 300 ms board ceilings remain

decision: keep multipart identifiers and part receipts in D1 behind opaque application IDs
why: server-owned receipts make retry and completion recovery possible without exposing private R2 state

decision: use task-scoped same-origin Worker routes for upload and range delivery
why: a parent-task join prevents confused-deputy file access while streamed bodies stay within Worker memory

decision: measure upload-attributable heap growth against the idle authenticated Worker baseline instead of applying a 64 MiB absolute heap ceiling
why: the inspector measured an 85306104 B idle framework heap before any media body and a 96469832 B peak during the fixture probe, disproving the absolute rule while bounding upload growth to 11163728 B

decision: move shadcn source, fonts, and monochrome tokens into one source-distributed @yatb/ui workspace
why: Web and Studio are now two real consumers and app-local copies would drift

decision: install only primitives with current callers and use explicit subpath exports
why: a small public surface avoids a speculative component library and keeps app dependencies visible

decision: capture the selected editor range before button focus and apply the link directly when the Dialog submits
why: Radix modal focus made the old focus-and-execCommand path lose the selected text

decision: stop the portaled link form submit at its React boundary and distinguish pending local HTML from applied prop HTML
why: portal events bubble through the React tree even when the DOM form is elsewhere; the outer video submit persisted and reloaded the stale script until propagation was stopped

decision: publish draft media metadata version and ready upload state in one D1 batch behind the existing upload completion boundary
why: a separate promotion call would expose an uploaded-but-not-a-draft recovery state while unified completion can reuse the proven R2 reconciliation lease

decision: reserve draft identity at upload begin and adopt an existing draft by media identity before allocating a version
why: stable identities and database uniqueness make repeated or ambiguous completion converge without duplicate versions

decision: store comment attachments once as parent-task footage and link them with composite same-task constraints
why: one R2 object must render in the comment and remain downloadable from footage without a second storage lifecycle

decision: persist browser-native duration metadata in integer milliseconds at upload begin
why: R2 preserves original bytes but does not provide media duration and bounded anchors need one durable task-scoped source

decision: keep the selected pair in URL search and all mutable review state inside two keyed instances of the existing pane
why: URL-owned IDs make reloads deterministic while side-and-draft keys reset only the changed pane and preserve the other pane's playback and composer

decision: register comparison as a non-nested sibling of the task detail route
why: TanStack nested the first file name under a component without an outlet, so the URL changed while the detail page remained visible; the trailing non-nesting underscore makes the generated parent the authenticated app route

decision: use native Cloudflare Email Sending from an isolated sender domain
why: the account enabled structured Worker sends for studio-mail.youraveragetechbro.com without recipient verification while binding restrictions preserve the two-address product boundary

decision: create the Worker with a route-free generated build config before attaching production triggers
why: Wrangler versions upload cannot create a new Worker; the temporary config allowed workers.dev boundary proof before the authoritative custom domain and cron were attached

decision: disable invocation logs while retaining errors and explicit logs
why: a live Tail probe exposed a synthetic query despite redact_query_string; Better Auth verification and reset tokens use queries, so removing stored request URLs is safer than relying on ambiguous real-time versus persisted redaction semantics
